Title: Sacrorum conciliorum nova et amplissima collectio, tomus decimus
Creator: Conciliar acts, 7th-8th c. (anonymous), edited by Giovanni Domenico Mansi (this is the
    1901 Welter facsimile reprint)
Publisher: Paris, H. Welter (facsimile of Mansi, Florence and Venice, 1759-1798), 1901
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: 1901 publication, out of US copyright by date; the item carries no copyright field of
    its own, so the imprint date is the basis, read directly 2026-10-23.
Language: lat
Source: Internet Archive item sacrorumconcilio0010vari
    (archive.org/details/sacrorumconcilio0010vari), fetched directly (curl, raw bytes)
    from the item's own _djvu.txt full-text file, 2026-10-23, Library thread (Era III).
Provenance note: Raw, uncorrected djvu OCR (rough). Runs of 2+ spaces collapsed to one; no wording
    changed. Sections: councils in order; the African synod letters of 646 at raw lines
    ~456, ~957, ~964. Credit line for a reader-facing page: "Mansi, Sacrorum conciliorum
    collectio X (Welter facsimile, 1901)". Whole text republishable.
Content note: Includes the letters of the African councils of 646 (Stephen of Byzacena, Victor of
    Carthage) against Monothelitism. Same basis as the Mansi 3, 4 and 7 facsimiles already
    vendored.
